help.label: Help about {{section}}
help.interception: Traffic from the devices in scope goes through the core, where routing rules can act on it.
help.dns: A DNS resolver translates a site name into an IP address.
help.outbounds: An outbound tells the core how to send a connection, for example directly or through a proxy server or group.
help.rules: Rules match traffic by conditions such as the site or device and determine how the core handles it.
help.title: How routes work
help.order: Rule order matters. If “YouTube → direct” comes before “YouTube on the TV → through a proxy”, the TV connects directly too. Put the TV rule first for the exception to work.
help.draft: Edits go into the draft. Review them with Apply. The router restores the previous version if you lose the connection and cannot confirm the change.
help.examples: See how outbounds, servers and groups work in real connections

starter.title: First steps
starter.description: Add a server or subscription to the draft to get started.

addServer.title: Add a server or subscription
addServer.description: Add a connection to the shared Routes draft.

interception.disabled: Interception is disabled in the router settings.
interception.all: Interception is configured for all devices.
interception.listed: Interception is configured for listed devices and subnets.
interception.scopeUnknown: Interception is enabled in the router settings. Device scope is unknown.

dns.rules_zero: No DNS rules in the config
dns.finalUnknown: No default resolver specified in the config

outbounds.subscriptionPending: Apply to load servers from the new subscription

rules.empty: No routing rules in the config
rules.suggestions: Choose a service to set up its route.

unavailable.title: Simple view is unavailable
unavailable.description: Open JSON to review or correct the configuration.

list.explanation: The core checks routing rules from top to bottom. If a device exception and a general service rule both match, the first terminal rule selects the outbound. Place the exception first.
list.filteredOrder: Show all rules to change their order.
list.advancedMove: Rule {{index}} has conditions or an action that Simple cannot move across. Open Editor to change this order.
list.covers: This move would put a general rule before a rule it covers. Keep the narrower rule first. The move crosses rule {{index}}.
list.unknown: Simple cannot tell whether these rules overlap. The move across rule {{index}} needs review in Editor.
list.unsafe: Simple cannot move this rule safely in the current draft. Review the configuration in JSON.
list.sourceUnavailable: The source of this set is unavailable.
